title: Making a GTK application in Haskell, part 1
summary: This is a tutorial article demonstrating how to build GTK GUI applications using Haskell programming language. It's the first part of a series that likely covers the basics of integrating GTK with Haskell's functional programming paradigm. The article addresses the challenge of creating graphical user interfaces in a purely functional language.
problem_solved: Shows how to leverage Haskell's strong type system and functional programming benefits while building cross-platform GUI applications with GTK.
why_valuable: Combines the safety and expressiveness of Haskell with GTK's mature GUI framework, offering an alternative for developers who prefer functional programming for desktop application development.
